en: A vintage postcard depicting a large, ornately decorated brick building with a sign reading 'Pädagogium' on its facade. There are several people, including boys in uniform, standing in front of the building and a tree-lined street. The text 'Gruss aus Bad Pyrmont' appears at the top, suggesting it is a greeting card from the town. The reverse side of the postcard is blank for writing, with printed red lines for an address and a stamp area. The words 'POSTKARTE' and publisher information are visible.
